title: Trinomial Kernel Evidence Alignment, Canonical Support Repair, and Certificate-Scope Correction
normalized_relation: a0 + a1 * (2*pi)^alpha + a2 * (2*pi)^beta = 0 with a0*a1*a2 != 0, alpha, beta in A_R, alpha/beta not in Q
support_canonicalization: Exact symbolic grouping via canonicalize_group_algebra_terms prior to support classification; eliminates cancelled grades and verifies primitive support
gelfond_schneider_dependency: dim_Q S_tau <= 1 (Baker / Gelfond-Schneider theorem) used to deduce contradiction from alpha, beta in S_tau
real_normalization_validation: Direct elementary proof: lambda = conj(a_pivot)/a_pivot with |lambda|=1; mu = 1 + lambda (or mu = I if lambda = -1); verified fail-closed on non-proportional vectors
orbit_nonpropagation_description: f(1) = 0 does not force f(2) = 0, f(3) = 0, or any further orbit vanishing.

relation_space_dimension_theorem.invariant_proof_mechanism: The 2x3 algebraic coefficient matrix M has rank 2, so its right nullspace over Q_bar is 1-dimensional. The vector (1, X, Y) spans this nullspace. Since the first coordinate is nonzero (1), the unique basis vector with first coordinate 1 is algebraic, forcing X, Y in Q_bar. Alternatively, the signed minor Delta_0 = a1*b2 - a2*b1 must be nonzero whenever (1, X, Y) is in the nullspace because Delta_0 is the first coordinate of the nullspace generator; hence Cramer's rule applies directly.
relation_space_dimension_theorem.external_contradiction: X, Y in Q_bar implies alpha, beta in S_tau. External Gelfond-Schneider forces dim_Q S_tau <= 1, contradicting Q-independence of alpha, beta.

exceptional_direction_conditions.denominator_nonvanishing_proof: If a1 + a2*(Y/X) == 0, then a0 = -X*(a1 + a2*(Y/X)) = 0, which contradicts nondegeneracy a0*a1*a2 != 0.

real_normalization_status.phase_normalization_mechanism: Generators X, Y in R_{>0} are real, so conjugation sends a relation to another relation. By dim R_{alpha, beta} <= 1, conj(a_j) = lambda * a_j with |lambda| = 1. Choosing mu = 1 + lambda (or mu = I if lambda = -1) satisfies conj(mu * a_j) = mu * a_j, yielding real algebraic coefficients in A_R.
real_normalization_status.fail_closed_validation: Tested in Python: raises ValueError on non-proportional conjugate coefficient vectors; returns exact symbolic expressions without real-part truncation.

sign_classification.affine_exceptional_relation_locus: A_tau = {(alpha, beta) in A_R^2 : 1, tau^alpha, tau^beta linearly dependent over Q_bar}

orbit_rigidity_status.statement: If f(n) = a0 + a1 * X^n + a2 * Y^n satisfies f(n) = f(n+1) = f(n+2) = 0 for distinct positive bases (1, X, Y), then a0 = a1 = a2 = 0.
orbit_rigidity_status.no_propagation_boundary: f(1) = 0 does not force f(2) = 0, f(3) = 0, or any further orbit vanishing. Dilation does not canonically propagate into contradictory grade orbits.

s_unit_theorem_applicability.base_group: Gamma_0 = <tau^alpha, tau^beta> \subset R_{>0}^x is free abelian of rank 2 (Gamma_0 \cong Z^2)
s_unit_theorem_applicability.ambient_solution_group: Independently varying (u, v) lives in Gamma_0 x Gamma_0 of rank 4
s_unit_theorem_applicability.diagonal_orbit_group: Delta_{alpha, beta} = {(X^n, Y^n) : n in Z} is a cyclic group of rank 1

torus_coset_status.proof_mechanism: The line a0 + a1*u + a2*v = 0 with nonzero coefficients contains no translate of an algebraic subtorus u^p * v^q = c of G_m^2, because binomial curves are nonlinear for (p, q) != (0, 0).
